crossRefs.note: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
“Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
translations.bsb: “But now, O Job, hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
translations.kjv: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
translations.asv: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, And hearken to all my words.
